task.title: How to Access Your NC State Gmail
task.shortdesc: Learn how to sign in to your NC State Gmail account using a web browser.

taskbody.context:
NC State uses Gmail as its email provider. Sign in using your NC State unity ID and university authentication credentials. The NC State Help Desk only supports logging into gmail.com and official Gmail apps.
The following steps outline the process to sign in to your NC State Gmail account on a computer.
To access your NCSU Gmail account on a mobile device, you should use the official Gmail app. Please refer to Google's instructions for signing in to Gmail on an Android device or an iPhone or iPad.

step.cmd: On your computer, go to Gmail.

ul.li: If you are already signed into a personal or other Google account and it takes you directly to your inbox, try signing into multiple accounts.
If it takes you to the Gmail login page, but the login information for your personal or other Google account is already filled in, select Use another account.
If you see a page describing Gmail instead of the Gmail login page, select Sign in in the upper-right corner of the page.

step.cmd: In the Email or Phone field, enter [your Unity ID]@ncsu.edu. Select Next.
On the Microsoft login page, enter your password. Select Sign in.
Select Continue to complete Duo authentication.
